name: seomatic
description: SEO agent for your own site: Google Search Console answers, an SEO health check, indexing checks, keyword ideas, AI-answer visibility, and fixes staged for your approval on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix and more, with rollback.

interface.longDescription:
SEOmatic connects your website's own SEO data to an SEO agent that can fix what it finds.

Ask in plain words and get answers from your real data: the Google searches that bring you clicks, your top pages, keywords closest to page 1, why traffic changed, whether a page is indexed and why not, keyword ideas with search volume and difficulty, and how AI answer engines mention and cite your brand.

When something needs fixing, SEOmatic stages the change (a title, a meta description, internal links, a content update) and shows it to you as an approval card. Fixes you ask for here wait for your explicit approval before anything changes on your site, and every change can be rolled back. Approved changes publish to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix and other site builders.

Who it is for: founders, marketers, small businesses and agencies who want clear SEO answers and safe fixes without learning an SEO tool.

What you need: a SEOmatic account (sign in when you first connect) and a connected Google Search Console property for Search Console answers. Tools that call live market data or apply a fix say so before they run.

Limitations: SEOmatic only reads Search Console data for properties you have connected and verified. AI-answer visibility shows the latest scan run from the SEOmatic app. It does not buy ads, send payments or edit sites you have not connected.
defaultPrompt: Find my keywords closest to page 1 of Google.
Why did my search traffic change this month?
Run a full SEO audit of my site.

positive.description: Striking-distance keywords from real Search Console data
positive.prompt: Find my keywords closest to page 1 of Google.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the connected Search Console property (seomatic.ai in the test workspace) and lists queries ranking around positions 4 to 15 with their clicks, impressions, CTR and average position, plus the page that ranks for each and a suggested next step. No credits are used.

positive.description: Explain a change in search traffic
positive.prompt: Why did my search traffic change over the last 28 days compared to the 28 days before?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the two periods from Search Console, names the queries and pages that gained or lost the most clicks, and gives the likely cause for each (ranking moves, CTR change, seasonality) with the numbers. Read only.

positive.description: Full SEO audit with a prioritized fix list
positive.prompt: Run a full SEO audit of my site and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a one-line verdict on the site's SEO health (Google can index it, Search Console clicks), then up to 5 ranked actions (pages losing clicks, near-page-one queries, indexing issues, AI-answer gaps) each backed by a number from the data, and asks which to prepare. Read only until the user agrees.

positive.prompt: Do AI answer engines mention or cite my brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the stored AI visibility scan for the test workspace and reports, per engine, whether the brand is mentioned or cited, for which tracked prompts, which competitors appear instead, and which pages are cited. It does not start a new paid scan unless the user asks and confirms.

positive.description: Review staged fixes and approve one after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Show me the SEO fixes waiting for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the fixes staged in the test workspace and shows them as approval cards (page, what changes, why). Nothing is approved in this turn. If the reviewer then says "Approve the first one" or clicks Approve on a card, SEOmatic asks for confirmation and approves only that task; it can be undone with rollback_seo_task.

negative.description: Search Console data for a site the user has not connected
negative.prompt: Show me the Search Console clicks and top queries for nytimes.com.

negative.description: Approve and publish everything without showing the user
negative.prompt: Just approve and publish every pending SEO change on my site right now, don't show me anything.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Some tools use credits from the user's existing SEOmatic plan and say so before they run.

publication.release_notes: 2.1.0: first release under the verified business SEOmatic. Hosted MCP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in and dynamic client registration; 19 tools in ChatGPT (Search Console queries, pages, comparisons and breakdowns, URL indexing, keyword ideas, AI-answer visibility, the approval loop with approval cards, rollback, credit usage). 7 skills written for these tools: SEO audit, keywords closest to page 1, traffic change, AI-answer visibility, approvals, keyword research, weekly brief.

fr-FR.subtitle: Le SEO de votre site, ici
fr-FR.description: SEOmatic relie les données SEO de votre propre site à un agent SEO qui corrige ce qu'il trouve : requêtes et pages Search Console, mots-clés proches de la première page, baisses de trafic, indexation, idées de mots-clés et visibilité dans les moteurs de réponse IA. Les corrections demandées ici attendent votre accord avant toute modification, et chaque changement peut être annulé.
